name: Emailit
title: emailit.com
shortDescription: Emailit offers a straightforward API designed for developers to send transactional and marketing emails efficiently. Users can integrate the service quickly using SMTP or Rest API, suitable for businesses of all sizes. Example use case: A startup can manage their email campaigns, track performance, and adjust strategies based on detailed analytics provided by Emailit.
pros: Quick integration with SMTP or Rest API
Pay only for emails sent, maximizing budget
